dc_exit.fallback: Pipes, tanks, building heat pumps and backup boilers keep working. The sidestream HX is the only DC-specific asset; an air-source central heat pump on the same pad replaces the DC heat, and the HSA decommissioning reserve pays for it.

water.note: TeraWulf's sealed glycol loop with dry coolers uses no lake water for cooling, so heat reuse does not cut lake withdrawals. It cuts dry-cooler fan energy, and the HSA covenant keeps the 1.008 MGD permit unused for cooling.
